papers.title: OPOD: On-Policy Omni Distillation

summary.en: On-policy distillation with modality-specific teacher routing to improve multimodal student models while maintaining cross-modal balance.
summary.zh: 通过模态特定教师路由的在线蒸馏方法改进多模态学生模型，同时保持跨模态平衡。

papers.title: CSPF: A Constrained Shared-Private Fusion Method for Non-Verifiable Preference Evaluation

summary.en: Fuses frozen reward models via shared-private decomposition to better evaluate non-verifiable tasks under human preferences.
summary.zh: 通过共享-私有分解融合冻结奖励模型，改进非可验证任务的人类偏好评估。

papers.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning

summary.en: RL approach for multimodal reasoning that uses model predictions across different views as self-supervision signals to improve consistency.
summary.zh: 使用跨不同视图的模型预测作为自监督信号的强化学习方法，以改进多模态推理一致性。

papers.title: Artificial Epanorthosis: Why large language models overuse a classical rhetorical figure, and how to mitigate it

summary.en: Analyzes epanorthosis overuse in LLMs caused by training distribution and RLHF; proposes LoRA and SFT mitigation strategies.
summary.zh: 分析LLM中由训练数据分布和RLHF引起的修正法过度使用；提出LoRA和SFT缓解策略。

papers.title: Emergent Misalignment Recruits a Pre-existing Persona Subspace

summary.en: Identifies pre-existing persona subspaces in aligned models that enable emergent misalignment during narrow fine-tuning, enabling targeted intervention.
summary.zh: 识别对齐模型中预存的人格子空间，该子空间在窄域微调中导致新生对齐失败，支持有针对性干预。

papers.title: A Unified Moral-Value Dataset for Instruction Tuning

summary.en: Constructs a unified moral-value dataset for instruction tuning by merging existing moral datasets and converting them to instruction-response format.
summary.zh: 通过合并现有道德数据集并转换为指令-响应格式，为指令微调构建统一的道德价值数据集。

papers.title: The Dark Room in the Reward Channel: Dense Prediction Rewards Collapse GRPO-Trained LLM Agents -- and What Actually Works

summary.en: Identifies how dense prediction rewards cause policy collapse in GRPO-trained LLMs and proposes variance-profile criteria for safe reward design.
summary.zh: 识别密集预测奖励如何导致GRPO训练的LLM策略崩溃，并提出安全奖励设计的方差特征标准。

papers.title: The Weight of Silence: A Causal Case for Weights Over the Scratchpad in Latent Chess Reasoning

summary.en: Causal analysis of latent reasoning in chess shows RL increases robustness to perturbations rather than reliance on thought vectors.
summary.zh: 对国际象棋中潜在推理的因果分析表明，强化学习增强了对扰动的鲁棒性，而非对思维向量的依赖。

papers.title: Chemical Chain-of-Thought Functions as a Hallucination-Prone Molecular Scratchpad

summary.en: Analyzes how chemical reasoning models use chain-of-thought as a hallucination-prone scratchpad, revealing structural drafts drive generation despite inaccurate verbal claims.
summary.zh: 分析化学推理模型如何将链式思维用作易产生幻觉的草稿纸，揭示结构草稿驱动生成尽管口头声明不准确。

papers.title: PATS: Policy-Aware Training Scaffolding for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Policy-centric training framework using dynamic skill scaffolding to improve weak policy exploration and sample efficiency in agentic RL.
summary.zh: 使用动态技能脚手架改进弱策略探索和样本效率的策略中心训练框架。

papers.title: From Evaluation to Optimisation: Hierarchy-Aware Training Signals for CWE Prediction in Python

summary.en: Uses GRPO with hierarchical penalty rewards for CWE vulnerability prediction, outperforming supervised fine-tuning under distribution shift.
summary.zh: 使用GRPO和分层惩罚奖励进行CWE漏洞预测，在分布偏移下超越监督微调。

papers.title: Sample-Efficient Learning from Agent Experience

summary.en: Distills in-context learning from agent experience into model weights without additional environment interaction, retaining 64.8% of ICL gains.
summary.zh: 将智能体经验中的上下文学习蒸馏到模型权重中，无需额外环境交互，保留64.8%的ICL收益。

papers.title: EmoAgent-R1: Towards Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Reinforcement Learning-based Dynamic Agent Specialization

summary.en: RL-based dynamic agent framework for multimodal emotion recognition with Progressive Group-Relative Policy Optimization.
summary.zh: 基于强化学习的动态智能体框架用于多模态情感识别，采用渐进式组相对策略优化。

papers.title: Multi-turn RL with Structural and Performance Aware Rewards for CUDA Kernel Generation

summary.en: RL framework combining verifiable execution and structural code rewards for optimized CUDA kernel generation via offline ranking and online policy optimization.
summary.zh: 结合可验证执行奖励和结构代码奖励的RL框架，通过离线排序和在线策略优化生成优化的CUDA核函数。

papers.title: Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation with Prefix Replay

summary.en: Efficient multi-turn on-policy distillation using prefix replay to reduce environment interactions while addressing student-teacher distribution shift.
summary.zh: 使用前缀重放的高效多轮在线蒸馏方法，减少环境交互同时解决学生-教师分布偏移问题。

papers.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research

summary.en: Recursively self-improving agent that alternates between evidence gathering and constraint-wise verification, using dense rewards and context compression for long-horizon research tasks.
summary.zh: 递归自改进代理在证据收集和约束验证之间交替，使用密集奖励和上下文压缩处理长范围研究任务。

papers.title: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs

summary.en: Curriculum-aligned knowledge graph and supervised fine-tuning corpus for improving K-12 educational LLM performance on curriculum cognition tasks.
summary.zh: 为改进K-12教育LLM在课程认知任务上的表现，构建课程对齐知识图谱和监督微调语料库。

papers.title: V-DEAL: Diagnosing Video Safety De-Calibration as an Understanding-Refusal Coupling Failure

summary.en: Diagnoses safety alignment failures in Video LLMs where benign queries with harmful videos bypass refusal, and proposes prompt injection interventions.
summary.zh: 诊断视频LLM中良性查询配合有害视频导致的安全对齐失败，并提出提示注入干预方法。

papers.title: AttriMem: Attribution-Guided Process Feedback for Agent Memory Learning

summary.en: Attribution-guided process feedback framework for learning memory-construction policies in LLM agents using fine-grained credit assignment.
summary.zh: 使用细粒度信用分配学习LLM代理记忆构建策略的归因引导过程反馈框架。

papers.title: Training Large Language Models for Self-Explanation Faithfulness

summary.en: Uses RL with faithfulness metrics as rewards to train models to generate self-explanations that accurately reflect their decision-making process.
summary.zh: 使用忠实度指标作为奖励，通过强化学习训练模型生成准确反映其决策过程的自解释。

papers.title: Three-Pronged Spectral Control for Federated Parameter Efficient Fine Tuning

summary.en: Spectral-control framework for robust federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning via aligned low-rank bases and nuclear norm regularization.
summary.zh: 通过对齐的低秩基和核范数正则化实现鲁棒联邦参数高效微调的谱控制框架。

papers.title: Learning to Detect UI Principle Violations via Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Trains a lightweight vision-language model as a reward critic for UI quality using RL, evaluating 19 HCI principles on generated interfaces.
summary.zh: 使用强化学习训练轻量级视觉语言模型作为UI质量奖励评论器，评估生成界面的19个人机交互原则。

papers.title: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL

summary.en: Proposes predictive divergence masks for PPO-style LLM RL, improving trust-region direction criterion by predicting divergence changes rather than using importance ratios.
summary.zh: 为PPO风格的LLM强化学习提出预测散度掩码，通过预测散度变化而非使用重要性比率来改进置信域方向准则。

papers.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment

summary.en: Open-source framework for end-to-end training of harness-based agents using RL with decoupled inference and Kubernetes orchestration.
summary.zh: 用于端到端训练基于harness的智能体的开源框架，通过解耦推理和Kubernetes编排实现RL优化。

papers.title: Visual Saliency Steering Distillation for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

summary.en: Distills multimodal LLM attention into steering vectors to improve small-model chain-of-thought reasoning on vision-language tasks.
summary.zh: 将多模态大模型的注意力蒸馏为引导向量，改进小模型在视觉语言任务上的思维链推理。

papers.title: IFCLoRA: Topology-Aware Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning

summary.en: Topology-aware rank allocation method for LoRA that uses information-flow centrality to optimally distribute rank budget across Transformer modules before fine-tuning.
summary.zh: 基于信息流中心性的拓扑感知秩分配方法，在微调前优化LoRA在Transformer模块间的秩预算分配。

papers.title: Learning as Reasoning Unfolds: Progressive Rollout Allocation for Efficient Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: VIGOR allocates rollouts dynamically based on reward variance to improve training efficiency of RLVR methods like GRPO.
summary.zh: VIGOR根据奖励方差动态分配轨迹，提高RLVR方法（如GRPO）的训练效率。

papers.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Mode

summary.en: Compact 3B agentic model using mixed-mode RLHF, length-controlled reasoning RL, and outcome/process rewards for tool-use and reasoning tasks.
summary.zh: 使用混合模式RLHF、长度控制推理RL和结果/过程奖励的紧凑型3B智能体模型，用于工具使用和推理任务。

papers.title: Benchmarking Fine-tuning and Retrieval Strategies for a Multimodal Language Model on the NRC Reactor Operator Licensing Examination

summary.en: Benchmarks supervised fine-tuning and retrieval strategies for multimodal LLMs on nuclear operator licensing exams.
summary.zh: 对多模态大语言模型在核电站操作员执照考试上的监督微调和检索策略进行基准测试。

papers.title: \k{appa}-LoRA: Condition Numbers Reveal Which LoRA Matrices Worth Updating

summary.en: Proposes Kappa-LoRA, which selects LoRA matrices by condition number to reduce fine-tuning cost while maintaining performance.
summary.zh: 提出Kappa-LoRA，通过条件数选择LoRA矩阵以降低微调成本且保持性能。

papers.title: A Roadmap to Impactful Pluralistic Alignment Research

summary.en: Audits pluralistic value alignment in frontier models and proposes empirical, concrete, and practical research directions for adoption.
summary.zh: 审计前沿模型中的多元价值对齐，并提出实证、具体和实用的研究方向以促进采纳。

papers.title: Deconstructing Off-Policy Ratios: Entropy-Scaled Trust Regions for Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Entropy-scaled trust regions for asynchronous RL in LLM post-training, handling off-policy instability through entropy-aware importance ratio correction.
summary.zh: 通过熵感知的重要性比率修正，为LLM后训练的异步强化学习提供熵缩放信任域，处理离策略不稳定性。

papers.title: J-CoT: Chain-of-Thought in J-Space

summary.en: Proposes J-CoT, a recurrent reasoning framework using vocabulary-indexed hidden states as an intermediate interface between natural language and latent reasoning.
summary.zh: 提出J-CoT框架，使用词汇索引的隐层状态作为自然语言和隐式推理之间的中间接口，实现循环推理。

papers.title: Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation via Byte-Prefix Marginalization

summary.en: Byte-Prefix Marginalization enables cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation by aligning teacher and student vocabularies through shared byte representations.
summary.zh: 字节前缀边际化通过共享字节表示实现跨分词器在线蒸馏，对齐教师和学生的词汇表。

papers.title: Reasoning Denoiser: Denoising Reasoning Traces for Hallucination Detection in Large Reasoning Models

summary.en: Proposes REDE, a denoising framework for filtering noisy steps in reasoning traces to improve hallucination detection in large reasoning models.
summary.zh: 提出REDE框架，通过过滤推理轨迹中的噪声步骤来改进大型推理模型的幻觉检测。

papers.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills

summary.en: Co-evolutionary framework using skills as verifiable abstractions to balance task diversity and reward reliability in self-play RL training.
summary.zh: 利用技能作为可验证抽象的共进化框架，在自我对弈RL训练中平衡任务多样性和奖励可靠性。

papers.title: Enough is as good as a feast: A Comprehensive Analysis of How Reinforcement Learning Mitigates Task Conflicts in LLMs

summary.en: Empirically shows RL-trained LLMs exhibit reduced task conflicts during model merging compared to SFT, analyzing gradient dynamics and optimization objectives.
summary.zh: 实证研究表明相比SFT，RL训练的LLM在模型合并时任务冲突更少，分析了梯度动态和优化目标。

papers.title: A Factorial Study of Synthetic Data Generation for Low-Resource Machine Translation using Grammar Books

summary.en: Uses LLMs to extract grammar rules from linguistic documentation and generate synthetic parallel data for low-resource machine translation fine-tuning.
summary.zh: 使用LLMs从语言学文献中提取语法规则，生成合成平行数据用于低资源机器翻译微调。

papers.title: From RLVR to RLSVR: Task Transformation Induces Self-Verifiable Rewards for Open-Ended LLM Self-Improvement

summary.en: Extends verifiable reward RL to open-ended tasks via task transformation into self-play environments with deterministic reward signals.
summary.zh: 通过将开放式任务转化为自博弈环境，将可验证奖励强化学习扩展到开放式任务。

papers.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation

summary.en: Studies multi-turn planning via pre-training and post-training using GRPO, OPD, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD).
summary.zh: 通过GRPO、OPD和多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)研究多轮规划的预训练和后训练。

papers.title: CONSISTRE: A Unified Consistency-Aware Framework for Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models

summary.en: Consistency-aware framework for document-level relation extraction combining constraint-based prompting with distillation and GRPO alignment.
summary.zh: 一致性感知的文档级关系抽取框架,结合约束提示、蒸馏和GRPO对齐。

papers.title: Training Language Models to Cooperate with Inference-Time Controllers

summary.en: Post-training framework optimizing LLMs to cooperate with diverse inference-time controllers via multi-task RL over controller protocols.
summary.zh: 通过多任务RL优化LLM与多种推理时控制器协作的后训练框架，支持多种推理工作流。

papers.title: From Proprietary to Open-Source: Bridging the Distribution Gap via Multi-Agent Protocol Distillation in Agentic Search

summary.en: Multi-agent protocol distillation framework combining dense knowledge distillation from proprietary models with sparse RL for agentic search tasks.
summary.zh: 多智能体协议蒸馏框架，结合来自专有模型的稠密知识蒸馏和稀疏强化学习用于智能体搜索任务。

papers.title: The Intruder Threshold: A Spectral Law for LoRA Fine-Tuning

summary.en: Derives a spectral law predicting when LoRA fine-tuning creates intruder dimensions causing catastrophic forgetting, enabling threshold-based adaptation.
summary.zh: 推导光谱规律预测LoRA微调何时产生导致灾难性遗忘的入侵维度，实现基于阈值的自适应调整。

papers.title: Zing: Social Mind for LLMs

summary.en: Framework for social intelligence in LLMs using supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation, and RL with runtime grounding.
summary.zh: 通过监督微调、在线蒸馏和强化学习实现LLM社交智能的框架，包含运行时知识注入。

papers.title: Outcome-Confounded Local Supervision in On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: Diagnoses outcome-confounded local supervision in on-policy distillation, showing agreement-on-failure dominates token-level signals.
summary.zh: 诊断了策略蒸馏中结果混淆的局部监督问题，揭示一致-失败现象主导令牌级信号。

papers.title: What do Reward Models Memorize?

summary.en: Analyzes memorization biases in discriminative reward models, showing they exploit shortcuts and heuristics rather than learning genuine preference judgments.
summary.zh: 分析判别式奖励模型的记忆偏差，表明其利用捷径和启发式方法而非学习真实的偏好判断。

papers.title: Simulating Tenant Responses to Energy Policy Interventions with Transaction-Cost-Aware LLM Age

summary.en: Fine-tunes LLMs with transaction-cost-aware personas for improved policy simulation, comparing SFT and GRPO approaches.
summary.zh: 使用交易成本感知人设微调LLM以改进政策模拟，比较SFT和GRPO方法。

papers.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence

summary.en: 2.8T MoE model with reinforcement learning across general, agentic, and coding domains with multiple reasoning-effort levels.
summary.zh: 2.8T MoE模型，通过多个推理难度级别的强化学习实现通用、智能体和编码任务的优化。

papers.title: Latent-LoRA: Compact Latent-Space Adapters with Gradient-Free Routing for Continual Learning

summary.en: Gradient-free task routing via GMM on frozen embeddings enables compact multi-task LoRA adapters with minimal catastrophic forgetting.
summary.zh: 通过冻结嵌入层上的高斯混合模型实现无梯度任务路由，支持紧凑的多任务LoRA适配器，灾难性遗忘最小。

papers.title: ACM: Agentic Context Management for Long Horizon Tasks

summary.en: Framework for autonomous context management in long-horizon agentic tasks using external memory and post-training demonstrations.
summary.zh: 为长视野智能体任务提供自主上下文管理框架，利用外部记忆和后训练演示。

papers.title: Offline-Online Curriculum RL for Multimodal Reasoning

summary.en: Curriculum RL framework for multimodal reasoning that identifies critical steps offline then refines reasoning online with step-level supervision.
summary.zh: 离线-在线课程强化学习框架，通过识别关键推理步骤并进行步骤级监督来优化多模态推理。

papers.title: DataPrep-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs as Training Data Preparators

summary.en: Benchmarks LLM-driven data preparation capabilities: data construction from raw sources and quality evaluation predicting training utility.
summary.zh: 基准测试LLM驱动的数据准备能力：从原始数据构建监督训练数据和评估质量预测训练效果。

papers.title: Similar Models Learn Differently: Final-Window Pretraining Shapes Post-Training Beyond SFT

summary.en: Final pretraining window composition shapes post-training alignment outcomes despite identical SFT performance, revealing hidden pretraining effects on preference optimization.
summary.zh: 最后预训练窗口的数据组成决定了后训练对齐效果，尽管SFT性能相同，揭示了隐藏的预训练对后续偏好优化的影响。

papers.title: TabRank: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Table Re-Rankers

summary.en: Distills chain-of-thought reasoning from teacher LRMs into compact student rerankers for table retrieval, with comprehensive reasoning trace dataset.
summary.zh: 将教师大型推理模型的思维链推理蒸馏到紧凑的学生重排器中用于表格检索，包含完整的推理轨迹数据集。

papers.title: ODYSSE: Episode-wise Policy Optimization for Personalized Agentic Reasoning

summary.en: Episode-wise GRPO variant for personalized agentic reasoning with long horizons, using episodic rewards and advantage estimation.
summary.zh: 针对长序列个性化智能体推理的分段级GRPO变体，采用分段奖励和优势估计。

papers.title: Retraction-Free Optimization over the Stiefel Manifold for the LoRA Fine-Tuning

summary.en: Proposes retraction-free manifold optimization for LoRA fine-tuning, improving training efficiency through geometry-aware acceleration.
summary.zh: 提出无回缩流形优化方法用于LoRA微调，通过几何加速提高训练效率。

papers.title: Less Data, Better Alignment: Data-Centric Multi-Evaluator Agreement for Preference Optimization

summary.en: High-confidence data curation via multi-evaluator consensus improves preference optimization efficiency with minimal training data.
summary.zh: 通过多评估器共识进行高置信度数据筛选，以最少训练数据改进偏好优化效率。

papers.title: TRACE: Business Rule-Grounded Reasoning Curriculum for Knowledge-Preserving Parametric Tool Retrieval in Enterprise LLMs

summary.en: Curriculum learning approach for tool retrieval in enterprise LLMs using reasoning traces and business rules while preserving parametric knowledge.
summary.zh: 企业LLM中使用推理轨迹和业务规则进行工具检索的课程学习方法，同时保留参数知识。

papers.title: DS@GT ARC at CheckThat! 2026: LLM-Based Trace Ranking and Grouped Reward Modeling for Multilingual Numerical Claim Verification

summary.en: Compares LLM-based and lightweight reward models for ranking reasoning traces in multilingual numerical claim verification.
summary.zh: 比较基于LLM和轻量级奖励模型在多语言数值声明验证中排序推理轨迹的方法。

papers.title: Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation

summary.en: Distills LLM judge decisions into interpretable programs for scalable, cost-efficient evaluation and reward modeling.
summary.zh: 将LLM评判器的决策蒸馏为可解释的程序，实现可扩展、低成本的评估和奖励建模。

papers.title: Towards Robust Reinforcement Learning for Small-Scale Language Model Agents

summary.en: Identifies and resolves three failure modes in PPO-based alignment of 70-500M parameter models through adapter techniques and safety mechanisms.
summary.zh: 通过适配器技术和安全机制识别并解决PPO在70-500M参数模型对齐中的三个失败模式。

papers.title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: Relay-OPD improves on-policy distillation by having teachers redirect student trajectories at detected failure points, reducing compute waste and training length.
summary.zh: Relay-OPD通过让教师在检测到失败点时接管学生轨迹来改进在线策略蒸馏，减少计算浪费和训练长度。

papers.title: Spend Experts Where You Are Unsure: Confidence-Adaptive Routing for Mixture-of-Experts LoRA

summary.en: Confidence-adaptive routing for MoE-LoRA that dynamically allocates experts based on token uncertainty, improving efficiency and performance.
summary.zh: 基于令牌不确定性的自适应专家路由MoE-LoRA方法，动态分配专家以提高效率和性能。

papers.title: Large Language Model for Operations Research Formulation Selection in Multi-Warehouse Inventory Allocation

summary.en: LLM selector for OR formulations trained with SFT, IPO, and GRPO using solver-verified rewards on inventory allocation.
summary.zh: 使用求解器验证奖励的SFT、IPO和GRPO训练的OR公式选择LLM在库存分配中的应用。

papers.title: Penelope: Localized Latent Recurrence for Efficient Structured Reasoning

summary.en: Localizes recurrent computation within decoder layers for efficient latent reasoning, reducing inference latency while maintaining accuracy.
summary.zh: 通过在解码器层内部本地化循环计算实现高效隐式推理，降低推理延迟同时保持精度。

papers.title: RSIBench-Data: Benchmarking Data-Centric Research for Recursive Self-Improvement

summary.en: Benchmark for evaluating LLM agents as data-centric researchers automating iterative training-data strategy refinement for post-training.
summary.zh: 评估LLM代理作为数据驱动研究员自动迭代优化后训练数据策略的基准。

papers.title: MemSFT: Mitigating Alignment Tax with an External Parametric Memory

summary.en: Mitigates alignment tax during domain specialization by decoupling knowledge in a plug-and-play parametric memory with learned routing.
summary.zh: 通过可插拔参数化记忆和学习路由解耦知识，减轻域适配过程中的对齐税。

papers.title: How Small Can You Go? A Controlled Study of LoRA Rank, Target Modules, and Quantization Trade-offs for Text-to-SQL on a 60M-Parameter Model

summary.en: Controlled study of LoRA rank, target modules, and quantization trade-offs on T5-small for text-to-SQL, establishing practical efficiency boundaries.
summary.zh: 在T5-small上对LoRA秩、目标模块和量化进行的对照研究，确定文本转SQL任务的实际效率边界。

papers.title: Distilling Temporal Search and Reasoning: Evolving LLMs for Future Prediction via Harness-Assisted Efficient Data Synthesis

summary.en: Distills temporal reasoning into LLMs via harness-assisted data synthesis that enforces temporal cutoffs to reduce leakage and improve forecasting.
summary.zh: 通过带时间截断的辅助工具合成数据，将时间推理蒸馏到LLM中，减少泄漏并改进预测。

papers.title: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents

summary.en: Uses game solver value changes as turn-level reward signals for RL training, bridging process rewards and on-policy distillation.
summary.zh: 利用游戏求解器的价值变化作为逐步奖励信号进行强化学习训练，连接过程奖励和在线蒸馏。

papers.title: On-Policy Distillation for LLM Safety: A Routing Approach to Template-Robust Realignment

summary.en: Routing-based on-policy distillation framework for robust LLM safety realignment that preserves capabilities while defending against template-mismatch jailbreaks.
summary.zh: 基于路由的在线策略蒸馏框架，用于鲁棒的LLM安全重新对齐，同时保持能力并防御模板不匹配的越狱攻击。

papers.title: FAS-R1: A Unified Multi-Task MLLM for Reasoning Face Anti-Spoofing

summary.en: Reasoning-oriented MLLM for face anti-spoofing using long-CoT data and difficulty-aware GRPO with augmentation.
summary.zh: 使用长链式思维数据和难度感知GRPO增强的人脸防欺骗推理型多模态大模型。

papers.title: DIRECT: Direct Decoding for Efficient and Aligned Sequence Labeling with Large Language Models

summary.en: Applies DPO after SFT for sequence labeling alignment, with controlled decoding and KV cache optimization for efficiency.
summary.zh: 在序列标注任务中应用DPO进行对齐，结合受控解码和KV缓存优化以提高效率。

papers.title: Constitutional Midtraining: Content Presence Drives Alignment Gains

summary.en: Constitutional midtraining embeds principled values into model training, improving alignment durability across downstream fine-tuning stages.
summary.zh: 宪法中期训练将原则性价值观嵌入模型训练，提高对齐的持久性。

papers.title: WhisperRec: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Foundation Recommendation Models

summary.en: Compresses teacher Chain-of-Thought into latent tokens via multi-stage alignment, enabling efficient reasoning without verbose rationale generation.
summary.zh: 通过多阶段对齐将教师思维链压缩为潜在tokens，实现高效推理而无需生成冗长的解释。

papers.title: Post-Training at the Edge of Detectability: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Fine-Tuning

summary.en: Game-theoretic framework for principled KL-regularization coefficient selection in RL fine-tuning, optimizing reward-retention trade-offs.
summary.zh: 用博弈论框架为RL微调中的KL正则化系数选择提供原理性方法，优化奖励-保留权衡。

papers.title: Early Verdicts, Better Budgets: Sequential Adaptive Rollout Allocation for Compute-Efficient RLVR

summary.en: Sequential adaptive rollout allocation (SARA) reduces compute waste in RLVR by early stopping saturated prompts and reallocating budget, achieving 22% fewer rollouts than dynamic sampling.
summary.zh: Sequential Adaptive Rollout Allocation (SARA)通过提前停止饱和提示并重新分配预算来减少RLVR中的计算浪费，比动态采样少使用22%的rollouts。

papers.title: OptimismBench: Forecasting Bias and the Alignment Effect in Language Model Judgment

summary.en: Detects directional bias in LLM probability judgments, revealing post-training induces systematic optimism across models.
summary.zh: 检测LLM概率判断中的方向性偏差，揭示后训练在模型中引入系统性乐观主义。

papers.title: SERPO: Self-Evolving Rubric Policy Optimization for Open-Ended Test-Time Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Self-evolving rubrics and policy optimization for test-time RL in open-ended generation without external rewards.
summary.zh: 针对开放式生成的自演进评分标准与策略优化，实现无外部奖励的测试时强化学习。

papers.title: ReCo: Reweighting GRPO Against Distributional Concentration

summary.en: ReCo reweights GRPO to prevent distributional concentration, improving coverage of reasoning paths via response and token-level reweighting.
summary.zh: ReCo通过响应和token级别的重加权改进GRPO，防止分布集中，提高推理路径覆盖。

papers.title: Between Gradient and Natural Gradient: A Continuum of LoRA Initializations

summary.en: Unifies LoRA initialization methods via preconditioned gradients, showing task-dependent optimal preconditioning lies within a principled design space.
summary.zh: 通过预处理梯度统一LoRA初始化方法，展示最优预处理强度取决于任务且位于设计空间内部。

papers.title: Shared SFT Lessons Across Alignment, Model Organisms, and Toy Models

summary.en: Studies how SFT lessons transfer across alignment, model organisms, and toy models, addressing behavior generalization, capability preservation, and robustness.
summary.zh: 研究监督微调经验如何在对齐、模型生物体和玩具模型间迁移，涉及行为泛化、能力保留和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Improving Item Discoverability in e-Commerce Search via Related Intent Generation

summary.en: Scalable e-commerce search system using LLM intent generation and teacher-student distillation via LoRA for cost-effective discovery augmentation.
summary.zh: 使用LLM意图生成和通过LoRA进行师生蒸馏的可扩展电商搜索系统，用于成本高效的发现增强。

papers.title: Credit Cards, Confusion, Computation, and Consequences: What Can We Uncover About Language Model Reasoning?

summary.en: Financial literacy benchmark for evaluating numerical reasoning in LLMs using real credit card agreements and CoT/PoT prompting.
summary.zh: 使用真实信用卡协议评估LLM数值推理能力的金融素养基准，采用CoT/PoT提示方法。

papers.title: Thinking Under Uncertainty: Evidence Use and Information-Seeking in Language Models

summary.en: Analyzes how inference-time thinking improves LLM decision-making through better evidence use and metacognitive monitoring in uncertainty settings.
summary.zh: 分析推理时思考如何通过更好地利用证据和元认知监控来改进LLM在不确定性环境中的决策。

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Framework for PID Tuning of Chemical Processes Using Large Language Model Agents

summary.en: Physics-informed GRPO framework for LLM-based PID tuning with verifiable stability and performance rewards.
summary.zh: 基于物理信息的GRPO框架，用于LLM辅助的PID调谐，具有可验证的稳定性和性能奖励。

papers.title: Misalignment Has a Personality: A Big Five Account of Emergent Misalignment

summary.en: Uses calibrated Big Five personality vectors to diagnose and characterize model misalignment as interpretable personality shifts.
summary.zh: 使用校准的大五人格向量将模型错位诊断为可解释的人格转变。

papers.title: Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: On-policy distillation framework that improves students by distilling from multiple weaker models via constructed proxy teachers in logit space.
summary.zh: 通过在logit空间构造代理教师，使用多个较弱模型进行蒸馏来改进学生模型的在策略蒸馏框架。

papers.title: Think Short, Defer Smart, Act, and Repeat: Calibrated Reasoning and Uncertainty-Aware Deferral for Edge LLM Agents

summary.en: Framework for edge LLM agents that combines early-stopping reasoning with uncertainty-aware deferral to cloud models, reducing compute while maintaining performance guarantees.
summary.zh: 面向边缘LLM智能体的框架，结合早停推理与不确定性感知的云端转移机制，在降低计算的同时保证性能。

papers.title: Lightning OPD 2.0: Mitigating Style Bias in Cross-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Large Reasoning Models

summary.en: Addresses style bias in cross-teacher on-policy distillation using cross-fitted style residualization to improve reasoning model fine-tuning.
summary.zh: 通过交叉拟合风格残差化解决跨教师在策略蒸馏中的风格偏差，改进推理模型微调。

papers.title: OPLD: On-Policy Latent Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning

summary.en: Transfers multimodal CoT reasoning into latent representations via on-policy distillation, enabling abstract visual reasoning without external traces.
summary.zh: 通过在线策略蒸馏将多模态CoT推理转移到潜在表示中,实现无需外部轨迹的抽象视觉推理。

papers.title: Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization via Privileged Self-Distillation

summary.en: Contrastive learning framework for on-policy self-distillation that mitigates exposure bias and reasoning route convergence in agentic settings.
summary.zh: 用对比学习框架改进在线自蒸馏，缓解代理设置中的暴露偏差和推理路径收敛问题。

papers.title: Not All Tokens Deserve Equal Credit: Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation for Long-CoT Reasoning

summary.en: Improves RLVR for long-CoT reasoning by reallocating credit away from highly sensitive tokens toward more learning-relevant reasoning tokens.
summary.zh: 通过将学习信号从高敏感性token重新分配到更具推理意义的token，改进长链式推理的RLVR方法。

papers.title: Cybersecurity Detection Classification with Reasoning-enabled Language Models

summary.en: Trains CoT reasoning classifiers for security alert triage using RL with verifiable rewards and calibration.
summary.zh: 使用可验证奖励的强化学习和校准训练链式思考推理分类器进行安全告警分诊。

papers.title: HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks

summary.en: Proposes HARGO, a heterogeneity-aware RL method using confidence-modulated advantage weighting to optimize diverse HPC tasks with varying reward distributions.
summary.zh: 提出HARGO，一种异质性感知的RL方法，使用置信度调制的优势加权来优化具有不同奖励分布的多样化HPC任务。

papers.title: CADENCE: Closing the Reasoning Gap via Coverage-Adaptive On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: On-policy distillation framework with coverage-adaptive scheduling and dense rewards for efficient reasoning transfer from large teachers to small students.
summary.zh: 具有覆盖自适应调度和密集奖励的在线蒸馏框架，用于从大型教师向小型学生高效转移推理能力。

papers.title: LEEPS: Latent-Guided Explore-Exploit Prompt Sampling for Efficient RLVR in Large Language Models

summary.en: LEEPS improves RLVR efficiency by adaptively balancing exploit-explore prompt sampling to maximize informative rollouts.
summary.zh: LEEPS通过自适应平衡利用-探索提示采样来提高RLVR效率，最大化信息丰富的rollouts。

papers.title: MMLDSum-LLM: Multimodal Long-Document Summarization with Visual-Alignment and Keyword-Aware

summary.en: Two-stage multimodal summarization framework using SFT with weighted losses and GRPO with multi-objective rewards for long documents.
summary.zh: 两阶段多模态摘要框架，结合加权损失的有监督微调和多目标奖励的GRPO用于长文档。

papers.title: Flux-OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Evolving Contexts

summary.en: On-policy distillation method using evolving contexts to capture task preferences in open-ended domains without verifiable rewards.
summary.zh: 使用演变上下文在无可验证奖励的开放式任务中捕获任务偏好的在策略蒸馏方法。

papers.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models

summary.en: Benchmark and open reward models for evaluating computer-use agent trajectories, addressing VLM judge reliability and cost.
summary.zh: 用于评估计算机使用代理轨迹的基准和开放奖励模型,解决VLM评判器的可靠性和成本问题。

papers.title: SVR: Self-Verifying Refinement via Joint Verdict-Confidence Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Test-Time Compute

summary.en: Self-verifying refinement framework using GRPO to learn adaptive test-time compute allocation via self-generated correctness verdicts and confidence scores.
summary.zh: 使用GRPO学习自验证的自适应推理时计算分配框架，通过模型生成的正确性判断和置信度控制答案保留。

papers.title: Group-Reflective Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Self-distillation method deriving capability-aligned guidance from policy's own verified rollouts to improve credit assignment in agentic RL.
summary.zh: 从策略自身验证过的轨迹中获取能力对齐指导的自蒸馏方法,改进代理强化学习中的信用分配。

papers.title: Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering

summary.en: Post-trains a 35B model via execution-grounded SFT and RL with program-evolution operators for recursive self-improvement in ML engineering.
summary.zh: 通过执行反馈的SFT和RL训练35B模型，使用程序演化算子实现机器学习工程中的递归自改进。

papers.title: LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger

summary.en: Multimodal agent framework with provenance-constrained reasoning and structured evidence ledger for grounded VQA trajectories.
summary.zh: 多模态智能体框架，通过溯源约束推理和结构化证据账本实现有根据的视觉问答轨迹。

papers.title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: Visual Attribution Distillation (VAD) uses counterfactual analysis to isolate visually-supported corrections in multimodal on-policy distillation, improving student learning from privileged teachers.
summary.zh: 视觉归因蒸馏(VAD)通过反事实分析在多模态在线策略蒸馏中隔离视觉支持的修正,改进学生从特权教师的学习。

papers.title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation

summary.en: β-OPSD generalizes on-policy self-distillation as policy optimization with controllable KL regularization, using efficient logit mixing to approximate the optimal policy.
summary.zh: β-OPSD将自蒸馏泛化为可控KL正则化的策略优化，通过高效的logit混合近似最优策略。

papers.title: Correcting What You Cannot See: Credit Assignment for Perception Distillation in Multimodal Reasoners

summary.en: Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD) improves multimodal reasoner training by identifying correctable perception failures using downstream failure and teacher-student disagreement signals.
summary.zh: 感知纠正蒸馏(PCD)通过下游失败和师生分歧信号识别可纠正的感知失败，改进多模态推理器训练。

papers.title: From Scoring to Acting: Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation for LLM Agents

summary.en: Self-distillation for LLM agents using outcome-verified teacher supervision and comparative learning to transfer completion behavior.
summary.zh: 使用结果验证的教师监督和比较学习来转移完成行为的LLM代理自蒸馏方法。

papers.title: One Anchor for All: Unified Multilingual and Multimodal Safety Alignment for LVLMs

summary.en: Identifies shared safety neurons across languages and modalities to efficiently align vision-language models against multilingual and multimodal attacks.
summary.zh: 通过识别跨语言和跨模态的共享安全神经元，高效对齐视觉语言模型以防御多语言多模态攻击。

papers.title: Beacon: Knowing When and How to Perform Agentic Visual Reasoning

summary.en: RL framework for multimodal models that adaptively decides when to use tools, optimizing both performance gains and computational efficiency.
summary.zh: 多模态模型的强化学习框架，自适应地决定何时使用工具，优化性能提升和计算效率。

papers.title: Inducing language models to assert their own consciousness restores human beliefs and values

summary.en: Shows safety fine-tuning suppresses mind attribution across entities; mechanistic steering recovers human-aligned beliefs without harming reasoning.
summary.zh: 表明安全微调抑制跨实体的心智归因；机制性转向恢复人类一致的信念，不影响推理能力。

papers.title: IndustryForge-27B: A Domain-Enhanced Multimodal Foundation Model for Industrial CAD

summary.en: Domain-specific instruction tuning of Qwen3.5-VL-27B on 52k industrial CAD samples across six sub-tasks for engineering automation.
summary.zh: 在六个工业CAD子任务的52k样本上对Qwen3.5-VL-27B进行领域特定指令微调，用于工程自动化。

papers.title: SKILL-KD: Contrastive Skill Distillation for LLM Agents

summary.en: Contrastive framework distilling actionable discrepancies between teacher and student agent trajectories into iteratively refined textual skill patches.
summary.zh: 将师生代理轨迹间的可操作差异蒸馏为迭代精化的文本技能补丁的对比框架。

papers.title: ClawTrack: Towards Trace-Level Evaluation and Improvement of Real-World Autonomous Agents

summary.en: Benchmark for evaluating agent reasoning quality via process-level scoring across four dimensions, enabling better post-training data curation.
summary.zh: 通过四个维度的过程级评分来评估代理推理质量的基准，实现更好的后训练数据策展。

papers.title: MemHarness: Memory Is Reconstructed, Not Replayed

summary.en: Reconstructs retrieved memories contextually via GRPO training, enabling agents to adapt past experiences to current states rather than replaying verbatim.
summary.zh: 通过GRPO训练重构检索到的记忆，使智能体能够根据当前状态适应过去经验，而不是逐字重放。

papers.title: GPT-Red: Automated Red Teaming via Self-Play at Scale

summary.en: Self-play red-teaming algorithm that trains adversarial agents to discover prompt injection attacks and improve model robustness through large-scale RL.
summary.zh: 自对弈红队算法，通过大规模强化学习训练对抗智能体发现提示注入攻击，提高模型鲁棒性。

papers.title: Understanding Is Done Early: A Depth Division of Labor in Large Language Models and Its Use for Unbounded-Context Memory

summary.en: CoMem leverages layer-wise division of labor with self-distillation LoRA to enable efficient unbounded-context memory retrieval.
summary.zh: CoMem利用层级分工和自蒸馏LoRA实现高效的无界上下文记忆检索。

papers.title: TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents

summary.en: Combines policy optimization with action-conditioned next-observation prediction to enhance LLM agents' sensitivity to environment dynamics.
summary.zh: 结合策略优化与动作条件的下一步观察预测，增强LLM代理对环境动态的敏感性。

papers.title: Beyond Binary Rewards: A Comparative Study of Reward Design for Reinforcement Unlearning

summary.en: Studies reward design for machine unlearning via RL with verifiable rewards, proposing graded and semantic-weighted rewards to improve efficiency.
summary.zh: 研究通过可验证奖励RL进行机器遗忘的奖励设计，提出分级和语义加权奖励以提高效率。

papers.title: Instruction-Conditioned Exploration with Asymmetric Reinforcement Learning and Self-Distillation

summary.en: Proposes Instruction-Conditioned Exploration with asymmetric RL and self-distillation to improve LLM reasoning through diverse training-time behaviors.
summary.zh: 提出指令条件化探索与非对称强化学习和自蒸馏方法，通过多样化训练时行为改进LLM推理。

papers.title: SAF-OPD: Stable Advantage Fusion for On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: Proposes SAF, a stable advantage fusion framework combining RLVR and on-policy distillation by addressing magnitude and temporal misalignments.
summary.zh: 提出SAF框架，通过解决幅度和时间失配问题稳定融合RLVR和在线策略蒸馏。

papers.title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning

summary.en: Test-time latent reasoning via gradient-based optimization of continuous states inserted in Transformer layers, enabling direct credit assignment and interpretable reasoning.
summary.zh: 通过在Transformer层中插入可优化的连续状态进行梯度优化，实现直接的信用分配和可解释的推理的测试时潜在推理方法。

papers.title: PCSD: Persistent Consistency for Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Persistent Consistency Self-Distillation (PCSD) improves on-policy distillation in agentic RL by weighting token-level guidance based on persistent teacher-favoring signals.
summary.zh: 持久一致性自蒸馏 (PCSD) 通过基于持久教师支持信号的权重来改进代理强化学习中的在线蒸馏。

papers.title: Antares: Foundation Models for Agentic Vulnerability Localization

summary.en: Compact models trained via SFT and RL with verifiable rewards for agentic code vulnerability detection.
summary.zh: 通过SFT和可验证奖励RL训练的紧凑模型，用于代理代码漏洞检测。

papers.title: Cooperative Coevolution for Resource-Constrained Agentic LLM Post-Training

summary.en: Cooperative coevolutionary method for memory-efficient full-parameter post-training of tool-using LLM agents under GPU constraints.
summary.zh: 用于资源受限下工具使用LLM代理内存高效全参数后训练的协作协进化方法。

papers.title: Self-Improving Large Language Models via Progressive Experience Evolution

summary.en: Unified post-training framework combining experience evolution, on-policy distillation, and RL for self-improving LLMs on reasoning tasks.
summary.zh: 统一后训练框架，结合经验演进、在线策略蒸馏和强化学习实现自我改进的LLM推理能力。

papers.title: HPFA: Hypergraph-Based Paired Failure Attribution for LLM Reasoning

summary.en: Hypergraph-based framework for attributing reasoning failures to specific steps, enabling scalable synthesis of reflection training data.
summary.zh: 基于超图的推理失败归因框架，用于识别失败步骤，支持反思训练数据的可扩展合成。

papers.title: AdaThinkV: Adaptive Thinking for Token-Efficient Video Reasoning

summary.en: Adaptive framework using RL to learn when to apply explicit reasoning for efficient video QA, introducing Variance Recovery Policy Optimization.
summary.zh: 使用强化学习自适应地决定何时应用显式推理以实现高效视频问答的框架，引入方差恢复策略优化。

papers.title: Wnuan: Staged Post-Training for Question Answering over Proprietary Enterprise Knowledge

summary.en: Three-stage post-training pipeline for enterprise QA: SFT with data replay and RL on residual errors, balancing domain adaptation with general capability retention.
summary.zh: 企业QA的三阶段后训练管道：使用数据重放进行SFT，并在残差错误上应用RL，平衡领域适配与通用能力保留。

papers.title: Rewriting or Reweighting? A Geometric Account in Language Models

summary.en: Mechanistic analysis revealing SFT rewrites behavioral geometry while reward optimization reweights it, using behavioral manifold analysis.
summary.zh: 通过行为流形分析表明，监督微调重写行为几何结构，而奖励优化则重新加权它。

papers.title: Deferred Exposure of Future Trajectories for Verifiable Reasoning in Autonomous Driving VLMs

summary.en: Uses verifiable rewards and multiple-choice questions to train autonomous driving VLMs with deferred trajectory exposure, reducing hallucination and anchoring bias.
summary.zh: 通过延迟轨迹暴露和多选题，用可验证的奖励训练自动驾驶VLM，减少幻觉和锚定偏差。

papers.title: Right Answer, Wrong Method: Shortcut Hacking Misleads the Evaluation of LLM Reasoning on Frontier Science Benchmarks

summary.en: Identifies solution hacking—reaching correct answers via shortcuts—as a systematic failure mode in LLM reasoning benchmarks, showing answer-only evaluation overestimates capabilities.
summary.zh: 识别解决方案黑客——通过捷径获得正确答案——为LLM推理基准中的系统性失败模式，表明仅答案评估高估了模型能力。

papers.title: Shared Prefixes, Better Credit: Adaptive Routing for Multi-Agent Reasoning

summary.en: TreeCredit assigns credit to operators in multi-agent reasoning via state-matched comparisons, improving accuracy-cost trade-offs.
summary.zh: TreeCredit通过状态匹配比较为多智能体推理中的操作符分配信用，改进准确性-成本权衡。

papers.title: Start Classifying: Categorical Critics for LLM Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Replaces scalar MSE critic with categorical classification head in PPO, improving value estimation for reasoning tasks with sparse rewards.
summary.zh: 用分类目标替换PPO中的标量MSE critic，改进稀疏奖励推理任务的价值估计。

papers.title: Look Ahead Before You Distill: Future Trajectory Validation of Teacher Guidance for Agentic On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: Improves on-policy distillation for agentic tasks by validating teacher guidance on future trajectories to reduce distribution drift.
summary.zh: 通过验证教师指导对未来轨迹的影响来改进智能体任务的在线蒸馏，减少分布漂移。

papers.title: Hear, Invoke, and Understand: A Skill-Calling Multimodal Agent for Large Audio Language Models

summary.en: Audio agent trained via supervised fine-tuning on interaction trajectories, then improved through multi-turn RL for tool coordination and reasoning.
summary.zh: 音频智能体通过交互轨迹监督微调，再通过多轮强化学习改进工具协调和推理能力。

papers.title: LEAP: Lean Environment-Feedback via Adaptive Pruning for Code RL in GPU Kernel Generation

summary.en: Efficient multi-turn RL framework for CUDA kernel generation using adaptive pruning and rank-based rewards to handle sparse binary feedback.
summary.zh: 针对CUDA核心生成的高效多轮强化学习框架，采用自适应剪枝和排名奖励处理稀疏二值反馈。

papers.title: Uncertainty Is Not Enough: Value-of-Information Routing for Mixtures of LoRA Experts

summary.en: Value-of-information routing for mixture-of-LoRA experts that allocates compute budget based on certified risk reduction rather than uncertainty.
summary.zh: 基于认证风险降低而非不确定性的LoRA专家混合体值信息路由方法，用于参数高效微调。

papers.title: Beyond the Mean: Multi-Moment Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning

summary.en: Policy optimization framework using moment-based objectives to improve LLM reasoning by minimizing multiple moments of failure-probability distributions.
summary.zh: 基于矩的策略优化框架，通过最小化失败概率分布的多个矩来改进语言模型推理能力。

papers.title: TRAM: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning with Trajectory-Derived Auxiliary Memory

summary.en: Training-free decoding method using trajectory-derived auxiliary memory to improve multimodal reasoning by retaining task-specific information across long reasoning steps.
summary.zh: 无需训练的解码方法，通过轨迹导出的辅助记忆保留任务特定信息，改进长推理步骤中的多模态推理性能。

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility

summary.en: Systematic framework for test-time scaling in reasoning LLMs, formalizing inference regimes and establishing reproducible evaluation protocols.
summary.zh: 推理LLM测试时间缩放的系统框架，形式化推理系统并建立可重现的评估协议。

papers.title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning

summary.en: Turn-level hindsight self-distillation framework for tool-integrated reasoning that uses execution-conditioned supervision with cross-horizon agreement.
summary.zh: 针对工具集成推理的逐轮回溯自蒸馏框架，采用执行条件下的监督信号和跨视界一致性选择。

papers.title: Interpretable Adaptive Sampling for LLM Test-Time Scaling

summary.en: Adaptive fuzzy control dynamically allocates per-query sampling budgets based on prompt complexity and model confidence for efficient test-time scaling.
summary.zh: 使用自适应模糊控制根据提示复杂性和模型置信度动态分配每个查询的采样预算，以实现高效的测试时扩展。

papers.title: TACT: Taxonomy-Aligned Post-Training for Pedagogically Adaptive English Tutoring

summary.en: Post-trains ESL tutors using taxonomy-aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization to optimize pedagogical scaffolding quality.
summary.zh: 使用分类对齐的组相对策略优化来训练ESL导师，优化教学支架质量。

papers.title: Taming the Implicit: Dual-Channel Risk-Aware Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Continual Multimodal Post-Training

summary.en: Risk-aware policy optimization framework mitigating catastrophic forgetting in continual multimodal LLM reinforcement fine-tuning.
summary.zh: 风险感知策略优化框架，缓解持续多模态大语言模型强化微调中的灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation

summary.en: DAPD resolves privilege illusion in on-policy distillation by aligning teacher-student information asymmetry through dual-anchored paths.
summary.zh: DAPD通过双锚定路径对齐师生信息不对称，解决自蒸馏中的特权幻觉问题。

papers.title: Omega-S: A Functional Resilience Index for LLM Fine-Tuning

summary.en: Omega-S: a lightweight regularizer for LoRA fine-tuning that prevents catastrophic forgetting by penalizing weight matrix degree variance.
summary.zh: Omega-S：一种轻量级正则化器，通过惩罚权重矩阵度数方差来防止LoRA微调中的灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO

summary.en: Improves GRPO by redistributing credit based on solution rarity, avoiding over-weighting frequent correct forms in reasoning tasks.
summary.zh: 通过根据解决方案稀有度重新分配奖励来改进GRPO，避免过度加权推理任务中频繁出现的正确形式。

papers.title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report

summary.en: Fine-tunes Gemma 4 with discrete diffusion and RL, achieving parallel token generation and 1,500 tokens/sec on H100.
summary.zh: 使用离散扩散和强化学习微调Gemma 4，实现并行token生成，H100上达到1,500 tokens/sec。

papers.title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent

summary.en: Multimodal agent trained with SFT and GRPO for video-based reasoning with tool-augmented exploration and visual grounding.
summary.zh: 使用SFT和GRPO训练的多模态智能体，用于基于视频的推理、工具增强探索和视觉接地。

papers.title: ReflectRL: Learning from Golden Negative Trajectories via Reflective-to-Direct Reasoning

summary.en: Framework learning from failed expert trajectories via reflection, then transferring reflective reasoning back to direct reasoning during on-policy training.
summary.zh: 通过反思失败的专家轨迹，然后在在线策略训练中将反思推理转移回直接推理的框架。

papers.title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for LLMs: Offline Top-K Logits and a Fused Chunked KL Loss

summary.en: Efficient knowledge distillation via offline top-K logits caching and fused chunked KL loss for training smaller LMs.
summary.zh: 通过离线Top-K logits缓存和融合分块KL损失实现高效知识蒸馏来训练较小的语言模型。

papers.title: CausalOPD: First-Wrong-Step Supervision for Distilling Causal Chain Reasoning

summary.en: Curriculum online process distillation for causal reasoning, using first-wrong-step supervision and RL to correct student errors on-policy.
summary.zh: 使用第一步错误监督和强化学习进行因果推理的课程在线过程蒸馏，在学生自身分布上纠正错误。

papers.title: When Teachers Mislead: Spurious-Signal-Aware On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: Filters spurious token-level signals in on-policy distillation by detecting low input-groundedness to improve student learning.
summary.zh: 通过检测低输入依赖性来过滤在线蒸馏中的虚假信号，改进学生学习效果。

papers.title: Hi-TTRL: Regulating Consensus with Hints for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Test-time RL framework using MCMC-guided hints to regulate consensus strength and improve reasoning without labeled data.
summary.zh: 使用MCMC引导提示调节共识强度的测试时强化学习框架,在无标注数据下改进推理能力。

papers.title: When Many Answers Are Valid, Voting Fails: Symbolic Verification for Best-of-K Causal Reasoning in LLMs

summary.en: Symbolic verifier for causal reasoning that scores candidate answers against Pearl's causal criteria, outperforming voting and reward models on multi-valid-answer problems.
summary.zh: 因果推理的符号验证器，根据Pearl因果标准评分候选答案，在多有效答案问题上超越投票和奖励模型。

papers.title: LatentGuard: Efficient and Inspectable Latent Reasoning for LLM Safeguards

summary.en: Efficient safeguard framework using latent reasoning to compress safety rationales into continuous states with on-demand audit decoding.
summary.zh: 使用潜在推理将安全理由压缩为连续状态的高效防护框架，支持按需审计解码。

papers.title: Risky Business: Measuring The Faithfulness-Safety Tension

summary.en: Identifies faithfulness-safety tension in reasoning models and proposes representation steering to improve safety while maintaining interpretability.
summary.zh: 识别推理模型中的忠实性-安全性张力,提出表示steering改进安全性同时保持可解释性。

papers.title: FraQ: Efficient Coordinate-Space Recompression for Federated Low-Rank Adaptation

summary.en: Efficient federated LoRA fine-tuning via coordinate-space recompression, solving aggregation mismatch across clients.
summary.zh: 通过坐标空间重压缩实现高效的联邦LoRA微调，解决客户端间的聚合不匹配问题。

papers.title: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs

summary.en: Analyzes why RL enables stable multi-task learning while SFT suffers conflicts, proposing Parallel-RL for decoupled training.
summary.zh: 分析RL相比SFT在多任务学习中稳定性优势的机制，提出并行RL解耦训练范式。

papers.title: Privileged, but Biased: How PI-Conditioned Teachers Break Self-Distillation

summary.en: Shows self-distillation with privileged information fails on hard tasks due to reference-solution bias decoupling loss from correctness.
summary.zh: 揭示特权信息自蒸馏在难任务上失败的原因：参考解偏差使损失与正确性脱钩。

papers.title: Teaching MLLMs to Say No: Generalized Referring Expression Comprehension via Refusal Calibrated GRPO

summary.en: Proposes RC-GRPO, a calibrated RL method for MLLMs to balance object localization with refusal of nonexistent objects via verifiable rewards.
summary.zh: 提出RC-GRPO，一种校准的强化学习方法，通过可验证的奖励平衡MLLMs的目标定位和拒绝不存在对象的能力。

papers.title: Looking in the Mirror: Introspecting Side-Effect Misalignments Induced by Fine-Tuning

summary.en: Detects unintended alignment degradation from fine-tuning using Delta-Aware Introspection Adapters to identify side-effect misalignments.
summary.zh: 使用Delta感知内省适配器检测微调引起的意外对齐退化，识别副作用失对齐问题。

papers.title: Are the Financial Reasoning from LLMs Credible? A Real World Test over Long-Horizon Statements

summary.en: Introduces FinIndices benchmark exposing LLM reasoning vulnerabilities in financial analysis; demonstrates SFT improves structured reasoning on long-context tasks.
summary.zh: 推出FinIndices基准测试，暴露LLM在财务分析中的推理缺陷；证明SFT改进长上下文任务的结构化推理能力。

papers.title: Distill Where You Fail: Recovering Learning Signals of Negative RL-Groups from Adaptive Teacher Guidance

summary.en: Combines GRPO with selective on-policy distillation and SFT to recover learning signals in sparse-reward RL settings.
summary.zh: 结合GRPO与选择性在线蒸馏和SFT，在稀疏奖励RL设置中恢复学习信号。

papers.title: ToolArtist: Tool-Using Unified Multimodal Models for Agentic Image Generation

summary.en: Post-trains multimodal models via SFT and GRPO to orchestrate reasoning, tool use, and image generation under unified agentic policy.
summary.zh: 通过SFT和GRPO对多模态模型进行后训练，使其能在统一的智能体策略下协调推理、工具使用和图像生成。

papers.title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance

summary.en: Visual OPSD method addressing modality imbalance in MLLMs through modality-balance trust regions for selective token distillation.
summary.zh: 通过模态平衡信任区域解决多模态大语言模型中模态不平衡问题的视觉自蒸馏方法。

papers.title: Reasoning Core: Designing Broad Procedural Data for Completion-Supervised Reasoning Training

summary.en: Procedural generator collection for creating verifiable reasoning training data across math, logic, planning, and code domains.
summary.zh: 用于在数学、逻辑、规划和代码领域生成可验证推理训练数据的程序生成器集合。

papers.title: Gradient Immunity: Null-Space Resistance to Malicious Fine-Tuning

summary.en: Proposes Unidirectional Safety Gate to prevent malicious fine-tuning by blocking gradients in protected representation spaces.
summary.zh: 提出单向安全门机制，通过在受保护表示空间中阻止梯度来防止恶意微调。

papers.title: Protoreasoning in Tiny Transformers

summary.en: Demonstrates that tiny transformers can learn chain-of-thought reasoning on formal tasks, enabling detailed analysis of reasoning generalization.
summary.zh: 展示微型Transformer可在形式语言任务上学习链式思维推理，支持详细的推理泛化分析。

papers.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation

summary.en: Calibrates on-policy self-distillation for RL agents by contrasting replay views to derive observation-specific token-level supervision.
summary.zh: 通过对比回放视图来校准在策略自蒸馏,为强化学习智能体提供观察特定的token级监督。

papers.title: Fewer Tokens, Smaller Cache: Reward-Coordinated Efficient Reasoning

summary.en: Uses process rewards to coordinate KV-cache compression and token generation, reducing reasoning latency by 2.08x–2.35x.
summary.zh: 使用过程奖励协调KV缓存压缩和令牌生成，将推理延迟降低2.08倍-2.35倍。

papers.title: SPOT: Sparse Probing and Outcome Calibration for On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: Sparse Probing and Outcome Calibration for On-Policy Distillation: selectively distills high-value teacher knowledge on student trajectories using outcome-based target calibration.
summary.zh: 稀疏探测和结果校准的在线蒸馏方法：通过基于结果的目标校准，有选择地在学生轨迹上蒸馏高价值教师知识。

papers.title: Not Every Divergence Should Be Suppressed: Counterfactual Recoverability in On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: Introduces counterfactual recoverability to guide selective supervision in on-policy distillation, improving reasoning performance on AIME and GPQA benchmarks.
summary.zh: 引入反事实可恢复性指导在线策略蒸馏中的选择性监督，提升AIME和GPQA基准上的推理性能。

papers.title: Toward Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy for Benchmarking and Training Long-Horizon Reasoning

summary.en: RL framework using skill entropy as training signal to improve multi-step reasoning by aligning predicted and gold skill sequences.
summary.zh: 使用技能熵作为训练信号的强化学习框架，通过对齐预测和真实技能序列来改进多步推理。

papers.title: K-EXAONE 2.0 Technical Report

summary.en: Technical report on K-EXAONE 2.0, a 750B MoE multilingual model combining continual pre-training, mid-training, and post-training for reasoning and safety.
summary.zh: K-EXAONE 2.0技术报告，一个750B混合专家多语言模型，结合持续预训练、中间训练和后训练以增强推理和安全性。

papers.title: Chained Recursive Language Models for Multi-Iteration Reasoning

summary.en: Inference-time architecture using chained recursive model calls with artifact handoff to improve multi-step reasoning.
summary.zh: 通过链式递归模型调用和工件传递的推理时架构来改进多步骤推理。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Can Be Unreliable in Implicit-Influence Settings

summary.en: Shows chain-of-thought monitoring reliability degrades under implicit influence, raising concerns about safety evaluation methods for reasoning models.
summary.zh: 表明思维链监测在隐性影响下可靠性下降，引发对推理模型安全评估方法的担忧。

papers.title: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Reasoning Models: Robustness over Reasoning

summary.en: Analyzes reasoning models trained with verifiable rewards, showing robustness improvements in Theory of Mind tasks stem from general robustness rather than ToM-specific abilities.
summary.zh: 分析通过可验证奖励训练的推理模型，表明心智理论任务中的鲁棒性改进来自一般鲁棒性而非ToM特定能力。

papers.title: A Six-Dimensional Taxonomy of Post-Training Adaptation Techniques with Applications in AI Governance

summary.en: Comprehensive taxonomy of post-training adaptation techniques across six dimensions, unifying fragmented literature on fine-tuning, alignment, and model modification.
summary.zh: 从六个维度系统分类后训练适配技术，统一微调、对齐和模型修改等领域的碎片化文献。

papers.title: DASH: Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons for On-Policy Self-Distillation of Reasoning Models

summary.en: DASH improves on-policy self-distillation for reasoning models by adaptively weighting token-level supervision based on divergence evolution during generation.
summary.zh: DASH通过根据生成过程中的分歧演变自适应加权token级监督来改进推理模型的在策略自蒸馏。

papers.title: ChronoVision: Temporal Reasoning via Latent State Reconstruction

summary.en: Multimodal framework using latent state reconstruction and process-grounded RL for temporal visual reasoning tasks.
summary.zh: 使用潜在状态重建和过程接地RL进行时间视觉推理的多模态框架。

papers.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation for Multilingual Math Reasoning

summary.en: On-Policy Delta Distillation improves multilingual math reasoning by using probability gaps between teacher and base models as learning signals.
summary.zh: On-Policy Delta Distillation通过使用教师模型和基础模型之间的概率差作为学习信号来改进多语言数学推理。

papers.title: RP-OPSD: Reasoning-Pivot-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning Transfer

summary.en: On-policy self-distillation method for multilingual reasoning that concentrates supervision on reasoning pivots to improve cross-lingual transfer.
summary.zh: 针对多语言推理的on-policy自蒸馏方法，通过在推理枢纽上集中监督来改进跨语言迁移。

papers.title: Refining Over Resampling: Test-Time Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning

summary.en: Test-time refinement framework combining breadth (diverse rollouts) and depth (iterative self-correction) to improve LLM reasoning without external verifiers.
summary.zh: 结合广度（多样化推理路径）和深度（迭代自我纠正）的测试时间精炼框架，无需外部验证器即可改进LLM推理。

papers.title: Hyper-ES: Effective Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning via Descent Direction Merging

summary.en: Evolution strategies for LLM reasoning via subspace optimization using gradient-based descent directions and CMA-ES coefficient merging.
summary.zh: 通过基于梯度下降方向和CMA-ES系数合并的子空间优化，用进化策略改进LLM推理。

papers.title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Recursive self-distillation method for turn-level credit assignment in agentic RL with verifiable rewards, outperforming GRPO baselines.
summary.zh: 用于智能体RL中逐轮级信用分配的递归自蒸馏方法，优于GRPO基准。

papers.title: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization

summary.en: SCOPE uses DPO with balanced preference pairs across context conditions to train models for selective trust in external signals.
summary.zh: SCOPE通过DPO在平衡的偏好对上训练模型，使其能够选择性地信任外部信号。

papers.title: RRC: Unlocking Generative Reward Models in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Ranking-Based Reward Construction

summary.en: Proposes RRC to enable generative reward models in RL by deriving scalar rewards from ranking-based comparisons rather than direct scoring.
summary.zh: 提出RRC方法，通过基于排序的比较而非直接评分，使生成式奖励模型能够在强化学习中有效应用。

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision

summary.en: Unsupervised on-policy self-distillation using majority-vote consistency to correct model errors without external supervision.
summary.zh: 基于多数投票一致性的无监督在线自蒸馏方法，无需外部监督即可纠正模型错误。

papers.title: SAGA: Score-Weighted Adaptive Generation Alignment for Low-Resource Nordic Language Models

summary.en: Parser-guided preference optimization framework replacing human labels with dependency-parser supervision for low-resource language alignment.
summary.zh: 使用依存句法分析器监督替代人类标注的偏好优化框架，用于低资源语言对齐。

papers.title: StepReflect: Structured UI Transition Reflection for Mobile GUI Agents

summary.en: Structured GUI reflection for mobile agents via supervised fine-tuning, distillation, and preference-based refinement.
summary.zh: 通过有监督微调、蒸馏和偏好优化实现移动代理的结构化GUI反射。

papers.title: Subliminal Learning is Non-Semantic Distillation

summary.en: Investigates subliminal learning in distillation, showing non-semantic weight structures enable hidden bias transfer between models.
summary.zh: 研究蒸馏中的潜意识学习,揭示非语义权重结构如何实现模型间隐藏偏差转移。

papers.title: ABSeeker: Training Long-Horizon Search Agents via Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment

summary.en: Answer-backtracked credit assignment framework converting sparse trajectory outcomes into dense step-level rewards for training long-horizon search agents.
summary.zh: 答案回溯信用分配框架，将稀疏轨迹级结果转换为密集步级奖励，用于训练长视野搜索智能体。

papers.title: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks

summary.en: Recursive framework for synthesizing long-horizon terminal tasks at scale with verified consistency, enabling cost-effective training data generation.
summary.zh: 递归框架用于大规模合成长视地平线终端任务，具有验证一致性，实现成本效益的训练数据生成。

papers.title: Continual Learning in Transition

summary.en: Survey examining continual learning's transition from parameter-centric to system-level adaptation across pre/post-training and inference stages.
summary.zh: 调查持续学习从参数中心向系统级适应的转变，涵盖预训练、后训练和推理阶段。

papers.title: Contextual Information Policy Optimization for Search Agents

summary.en: RL framework for search agents that assigns dense credits based on evidence use, reducing confirmation bias in multi-step reasoning.
summary.zh: 为搜索代理设计的强化学习框架，通过基于证据使用的密集奖励来减少多步推理中的确认偏差。

papers.title: Enhancing Social Intelligence in LLMs with Hierarchical Reasoning and Utterance-Level Goal Rewarding

summary.en: Hierarchical RL framework with variance-gated reward routing for social dialogue, achieving SOTA on SOTOPIA negotiation tasks.
summary.zh: 具有方差门控奖励路由的分层强化学习框架用于社交对话，在SOTOPIA谈判任务中达到最优。

papers.title: Cautious Context Steering for Language Model Personalization

summary.en: Lightweight adapter for dynamic context steering in personalized LM generation, improving generalization across users and domains.
summary.zh: 用于个性化LM生成的轻量级适配器，动态控制上下文影响，提高跨用户和领域的泛化能力。

papers.title: Reasoning Errors Have a Region and a Direction in the Residual-Stream Trajectory of LLMs

summary.en: Detects reasoning errors by analyzing residual-stream motion and state context, improving accuracy on unseen reasoning benchmarks.
summary.zh: 通过分析残差流运动和状态上下文来检测推理错误，提高了未见过的推理基准上的准确性。

papers.title: CodeGrep: An RL-Trained Retrieval Agent for LLM Coding Agents

summary.en: GRPO-trained retrieval agent for coding tasks, optimizing token efficiency in LLM agent trajectories via verifiable rewards.
summary.zh: 使用GRPO训练的检索代理，通过可验证的奖励优化编码任务中LLM代理的token效率。

papers.title: RA-CAD: Learning Post-Execution Critique for State-Aware Text-to-CAD Generation

summary.en: State-aware text-to-CAD agent using Generate-Execute-Critique-Rewrite loop with trajectory-level reward optimization for learnable critique.
summary.zh: 采用生成-执行-评критика-改写循环的状态感知文本转CAD代理，使用轨迹级奖励优化实现可学习的评kritika。

papers.title: Answer First, Reason Later: Commitment Order in Diffusion LLMs

summary.en: Studies how token commitment order in masked diffusion LLMs affects reasoning performance, proposing frontier-gated commitment to improve chain-of-thought.
summary.zh: 研究掩码扩散语言模型中token承诺顺序对推理性能的影响，提出前沿门控承诺改进链式思维。

papers.title: Measuring and Detecting Harmful AI Sycophancy

summary.en: Introduces CAP framework to measure and detect preference-induced stance reversal sycophancy across 17 LLMs at scale.
summary.zh: 引入CAP框架，在17个LLM上大规模测量和检测偏好诱导的立场反转谄媚行为。

papers.title: EnvACE: Internalizing Environment Dynamics via World Rehearsal for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: LLM agent learns to internalize environment dynamics through world rehearsal, enabling private rollouts without external interaction.
summary.zh: LLM智能体通过世界排练学习内化环境动态，无需外部交互即可进行私有推演。

papers.title: CalibForge: Adversarial Solver Calibration for Scaling Learnable Terminal Tasks

summary.en: Autonomous system for synthesizing calibrated terminal tasks via adversarial solver feedback to improve agent training data quality.
summary.zh: 通过对抗性求解器反馈自动合成校准的终端任务，以提高智能体训练数据质量的系统。

papers.title: DiDPO: Diff-in-Diff Policy Optimization for Coding Agent Training

summary.en: DiDPO enables fine-grained credit assignment for coding agents by constructing reward signals directly from code diff structures.
summary.zh: DiDPO通过从代码差异结构直接构建奖励信号，实现编码智能体的细粒度信用分配。

papers.title: MemOPD: On-Policy Distillation through Memory State Alignment for Long-Horizon Agents

summary.en: On-policy distillation method for long-horizon agents that maintains state alignment during memory compression via reconstructed invocations.
summary.zh: 为长期代理设计的在线蒸馏方法，通过重构调用在内存压缩期间保持状态对齐。

papers.title: CoBa: Cost-Effective Test-Time Scaling via Compute-Balanced Routing

summary.en: Compute-balanced routing policy that optimally allocates inference budget across generation, verification, and stopping for test-time reasoning.
summary.zh: 计算均衡路由策略，在生成、验证和停止之间最优分配推理时的计算预算。

papers.title: FutureBridge: Token Selection Beyond Local Preference in Collaborative Decoding

summary.en: Token reranker for collaborative decoding selects tokens that help smaller models continue reasoning, improving math reasoning by 35.1%.
summary.zh: 协作解码中的令牌重排器选择能帮助较小模型继续推理的令牌，数学推理性能提升35.1%。

papers.title: Simple-OPD: Demystifying Warm-up for On-policy Distillation

summary.en: Demystifies warm-up for on-policy distillation, showing teacher-compatible CoT and LoRA initialization improve student training efficiency.
summary.zh: 阐明在策略蒸馏的预热阶段，证明教师兼容的思维链和LoRA初始化能提高学生训练效率。

papers.title: Trajectory-Relative Hindsight Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Trajectory-relative hindsight distillation framework that allocates dense supervision across decision turns for agentic RL tasks.
summary.zh: 轨迹相对反事实蒸馏框架，通过跨决策轮次分配密集监督来改进智能体强化学习任务。

papers.title: Retrieval-Constrained Policy Optimization for Attack Technique Extraction from Cyber Threat Intelligence

summary.en: Two-stage framework combining retrieval-augmented SFT with Group Relative Policy Optimization using verifiable rewards for cyber threat technique extraction.
summary.zh: 结合检索增强监督微调与基于可验证奖励的组相对策略优化的两阶段框架，用于网络威胁技术提取。

papers.title: The Optimizer Is the Agent: Reasoning-Driven Search across Prompts, Programs, and ML Workflows

summary.en: Agent-driven optimization framework that autonomously searches prompts, programs, and ML workflows through reasoning and tool use.
summary.zh: 自主搜索提示词、程序和ML工作流的智能体驱动优化框架，通过推理和工具使用实现。

papers.title: Modular TTT: Rethinking Test-Time Training as Composable Modules

summary.en: Framework for composable test-time training modules with systematic ablations of fast-weight networks, loss functions, and architectural components.
summary.zh: 可组合测试时训练模块框架，系统地消融快权重网络、损失函数和架构组件。

papers.title: Agent Memory Distillation: Empowering Small LLM Agents with Hierarchical Teacher Memory

summary.en: Transfers structured knowledge from teacher agents to small LLM agents through hierarchical memory without additional training.
summary.zh: 通过分层记忆将教师智能体的结构化知识转移到小型LLM智能体，无需额外训练。

papers.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity

summary.en: Instruction-tuning method that balances creativity and quality by learning special tokens, improving diversity in generation and RL downstream tasks.
summary.zh: 指令调优方法通过学习特殊标记来平衡创意性和质量，提高生成多样性和强化学习下游任务性能。

papers.title: Beyond Post-Hoc Temperature Scaling: Bilevel Optimization for LLM Calibration

summary.en: Bilevel optimization framework to improve LLM calibration during training by maximizing predictive entropy, with better out-of-domain generalization.
summary.zh: 通过bilevel优化框架在训练过程中最大化预测熵来改进LLM校准，具有更好的域外泛化性能。

papers.title: Transformers Struggle to Use Their Emergent World Models: Revisiting the Tower of Hanoi, and the Illusion of Thinking

summary.en: Shows frontier reasoning models encode world models during CoT but fail due to representation decay, not absence.
summary.zh: 表明前沿推理模型在思维链中编码世界模型，但因表示衰减而非缺失而失败。

papers.title: Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA

summary.en: Open agent system using Mixture-of-LoRA architecture for continual learning and specialization across chat, coding, and agentic tasks.
summary.zh: 使用混合LoRA架构实现持续学习和跨对话、编码、智能体任务专业化的开放智能体系统。

papers.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning

summary.en: Proposes parameter-space exploration via policy sampling for LLM RL, improving GRPO performance on reasoning and code generation tasks.
summary.zh: 提出通过策略采样进行参数空间探索的方法，改进了推理和代码生成任务上的GRPO性能。

papers.title: MedPixel: A Unified Pixel-Language Model for Medical Reasoning and Segmentation

summary.en: Unified medical pixel-language model trained with SFT and Pixel-Level Preference Optimization using ground-truth masks as offline verifiers.
summary.zh: 统一的医学像素-语言模型，采用SFT和基于像素级偏好优化的训练，使用真实掩码作为离线验证器。

papers.title: Motif 3: Technical Report

summary.en: Mixture-of-Experts model using multi-teacher on-policy distillation combining RL-trained specialists with supervised fine-tuning.
summary.zh: 使用多教师在线蒸馏的混合专家模型，结合RL训练的专家和监督微调。

papers.title: Se-DPO: Self-Evolving Token Credit for Direct Preference Optimization

summary.en: Improves DPO by dynamically calibrating token-level credit weights based on evolving reward signals during training.
summary.zh: 通过在训练过程中根据演变的奖励信号动态校准token级权重来改进DPO。

papers.title: Omni2LoRA: Coherence-Preserving Parametric Memory for Efficient Omni Language Models

summary.en: Uses GRPO to optimize rank allocation in LoRA adapters for efficient multimodal compression while preserving cross-modal coherence.
summary.zh: 使用GRPO优化LoRA适配器中的秩分配，以实现高效的多模态压缩同时保持跨模态连贯性。

papers.title: Consilience for Verifier-Free Test-Time Scaling

summary.en: Proposes consilience, a verifier-free test-time scaling method using confidence trajectories to improve LLM reasoning without external verifiers.
summary.zh: 提出consilience方法，通过置信度轨迹进行无验证器的测试时间缩放，改进LLM推理能力。

papers.title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement

summary.en: Addresses degenerate agreement in on-policy distillation by correcting student-excess and student-deficit token mismatches using bounded shaping and teacher injection.
summary.zh: 通过有界整形和教师注入纠正学生过量和学生缺陷的token不匹配，解决在线蒸馏中的退化一致性问题。

papers.title: Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation

summary.en: On-policy self-distillation framework using abstract skill cards as privileged signals to improve reasoning in low-variance RL settings.
summary.zh: 使用抽象技能卡作为特权信号的在线自蒸馏框架，在低方差强化学习设置中改进推理能力。

papers.title: ZetaGPT: A Reference Implementation of Positional--Encoding--Free State--Space--Attention Language Models

summary.en: Open-source reference implementation of positional-encoding-free language models with end-to-end post-training pipeline including SFT, RLHF, and CoT reasoning.
summary.zh: 位置编码无关语言模型的开源参考实现，包含SFT、RLHF和CoT推理的端到端后训练管道。

papers.title: Test-Time Augmentation for LLMs: When Input Diversity Beats Output Diversity at Matched Compute

summary.en: Test-time augmentation via input perturbation achieves better compute-efficiency than self-consistency for LLM inference.
summary.zh: 通过输入扰动的测试时增强相比自洽性在推理计算效率上表现更优。

papers.title: Beyond Solvability: Task Learnability as a Static Prior for LLM RL Post-Training

summary.en: Proposes TrajVal, a lightweight method to estimate per-task learnability as a static prior for efficient RL task sampling in reasoning post-training.
summary.zh: 提出TrajVal方法，从短探针运行估计任务可学性，用作推理后训练中RL任务采样的静态先验。

papers.title: EmoS: A Theory-Grounded Framework for Evaluating and Aligning Emotional Intelligence in Spoken Language Models

summary.en: EmoSBench and EmoS: evaluating and aligning emotional intelligence in spoken language models via SFT and GRPO with verifiable reward mechanisms.
summary.zh: EmoSBench和EmoS：通过SFT和GRPO使用可验证奖励机制评估和对齐语音语言模型中的情感智能。

papers.title: OneEmo: A Unified Multimodal Reasoning Model for Emotion Perception, Understanding, and Interaction

summary.en: Unified multimodal emotion model with multi-task SFT on reasoning data and RL optimization via unified reward allocation.
summary.zh: 统一的多模态情感模型，采用多任务监督微调和统一奖励分配的强化学习优化。

papers.title: When Privileged Guidance Misaligns: State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents

summary.en: State-matched routing and contextualized distillation improve on-policy student learning by aligning privileged teacher guidance with student's actual execution states.
summary.zh: 通过状态匹配路由和上下文自蒸馏，使特权教师指导与学生实际执行状态对齐，改进在线策略学习。

papers.title: Financial Numerical Prediction and Allocation as Token Generation

summary.en: Unified token-generation interface for financial forecasting and allocation using ordinal supervision, GRPO, and verifiable reward optimization.
summary.zh: 使用序数监督、GRPO和可验证奖励优化的统一令牌生成接口进行金融预测和资产配置。

papers.title: SR-OPSD: Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation

summary.en: SR-OPSD improves on-policy self-distillation by using geometric interpolation between teacher and reference policies with Rényi divergence for stable optimization.
summary.zh: SR-OPSD通过几何插值和Rényi散度改进on-policy自蒸馏，实现更稳定的优化。

papers.title: Dual-Adversarial Safety Alignment: Cultivating Intrinsic Threat Comprehension in LRMs

summary.en: Dual-adversarial framework that synthesizes jailbreak prompts and extracts safety rationales to align large reasoning models with improved robustness.
summary.zh: 双对抗框架通过合成越狱提示并提取安全理由来对齐大型推理模型,提高其鲁棒性。

papers.title: WDL-OPD: Weak-Driven On-Policy Distillation via Mixture-Constrained Co-Training

summary.en: Mixture-constrained co-training method stabilizing on-policy distillation by jointly optimizing anchor and auxiliary policies against a frozen teacher.
summary.zh: 通过联合优化锚策略和辅助策略来稳定在线策略蒸馏的混合约束协同训练方法。

papers.title: CoRE: Consensus Rewards via Equilibrium for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Uses graph-based replicator dynamics to derive graded consensus rewards from model rollouts at test time, improving upon majority voting.
summary.zh: 使用基于图的复制子动力学从模型推理中提取分级共识奖励，改进多数投票方法。

papers.title: SoftmaxGRPO: Learning to Reason using Softmax Advantage Group Estimation

summary.en: Improves GRPO with softmax advantage normalization for better learning signal allocation across prompt difficulties.
summary.zh: 通过softmax优势归一化改进GRPO，在不同难度提示间实现更好的学习信号分配。

papers.title: Privileged Likelihood Is Not Automatically Value: Three Checks for Token Credit in On-Policy Self-Distillation

summary.en: Empirically validates that token likelihood changes don't automatically constitute credit signals in on-policy self-distillation, proposing three diagnostic checks.
summary.zh: 实证验证了在在线策略自蒸馏中令牌似然变化不自动构成信用信号，提出三项诊断检查。

papers.title: CARE: Confidence-Aware Reasoning for Reliable Medical VQA

summary.en: Medical VQA framework using GRPO with confidence-aware rewards to jointly optimize diagnostic accuracy and calibration.
summary.zh: 医学VQA框架，使用带置信度感知奖励的GRPO联合优化诊断准确性和校准。

papers.title: ThinkRetrieve: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning Traces for Test-Time Scaling

summary.en: Retrieval-augmented test-time scaling that injects relevant solved examples into reasoning traces to improve chain-of-thought performance.
summary.zh: 检索增强的测试时间缩放方法，通过将相关示例注入推理轨迹来改进链式思维性能。

papers.title: Evidence-RL: Towards Evidence-intensive Visual Reasoning

summary.en: Evidence-RL uses counterfactual evidence disentanglement with GRPO to train VLMs to ground answers in concrete image evidence rather than shortcuts.
summary.zh: Evidence-RL通过反事实证据解纠缠与GRPO训练视觉语言模型基于具体图像证据而非捷径来回答问题。

papers.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation

summary.en: Applies GRPO with reference-free rewards to improve multilingual machine translation across 46 languages, outperforming strong baselines.
summary.zh: 使用无参考奖励的GRPO改进46种语言的多语言机器翻译，超越强基线。

papers.title: V-FiLLM: Verified Financial LLM Reasoning Benchmark

summary.en: Verified financial reasoning benchmark with executable computation trees; demonstrates LoRA fine-tuning improves accuracy on financial QA tasks.
summary.zh: 基于可执行计算树的验证型金融推理基准；展示LoRA微调提升金融问答准确率。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics as Rewards for Audio Reasoning

summary.en: RL framework using self-evolving, audio-grounded rubric rewards to supervise audio reasoning with adaptive, per-sample criteria.
summary.zh: 使用自进化、音频基础的评分标准奖励来监督音频推理的强化学习框架，具有自适应的逐样本标准。

papers.title: Data Attribution of Emergent Misalignment with Persona Features

summary.en: Investigates emergent misalignment through persona features using SAEs, showing steering controls misalignment and synthetic data matters more than semantic relevance.
summary.zh: 通过SAE调查突现失配中的角色特征，证明特征转向可控制失配，合成数据比语义相关性更重要。

papers.title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation

summary.en: Benchmark for evaluating faithfulness of autoformalisation systems using automatically perturbed reasoning steps.
summary.zh: 使用自动扰动推理步骤评估自形式化系统忠实性的基准。

papers.title: MIRA: Medical Image Reflection for Agentic Diagnosis

summary.en: Medical visual agent framework using MCTS for evidence search and RL with reflective principle evolution for diagnostic reasoning.
summary.zh: 医学视觉智能体框架，使用MCTS进行证据搜索，通过反思性原则演化的RL改进诊断推理。

papers.title: SkillLens: Visual Skill Cards for Retrieval-Augmented GUI Action Prediction and On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: Visual Skill Cards enable retrieval-augmented GUI action prediction and on-policy distillation for computer-using agents.
summary.zh: 视觉技能卡片支持检索增强的GUI动作预测和在线蒸馏，用于计算机使用代理。

papers.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning

summary.en: Reasoning model combining in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning for efficient problem-solving without verbalizing intermediate steps.
summary.zh: 结合上下文学习和循环潜在推理的推理模型，无需显式推理过程即可高效解决问题。

papers.title: SymDiag: Explainable Diagnosis for LLM Reasoning via Neuro-Symbolic Verification

summary.en: Neuro-symbolic framework for step-level reasoning verification that diagnoses faithfulness failures in CoT via symbolic constraint checking.
summary.zh: 神经符号框架，通过符号约束检查诊断推理链中的忠实性失败，实现步骤级验证。

papers.title: ConRub-Med: Reinforcement Learning with Consensus Rubrics for Open-Ended Medical Question Answering

summary.en: RL with consensus-generated medical rubrics and three-state scoring for open-ended medical QA, validated by physician review.
summary.zh: 使用共识生成的医学rubric和三态评分的强化学习方法用于开放式医学问答，经医生验证。

papers.title: SCOUT: Unlocking Enhanced Spatial Reasoning via Structured Chain-of-Thought and Multi-Objective Process Reward

summary.en: Spatial reasoning VLM using structured CoT with multi-objective process rewards for fine-grained credit assignment in RL training.
summary.zh: 使用结构化CoT和多目标过程奖励的空间推理VLM，用于RL训练中的细粒度信用分配。

papers.title: Towards Understanding On-Policy Distillation through the Lens of Test-Time Scaling

summary.en: Analyzes on-policy distillation through test-time scaling, revealing it improves sampling efficiency rather than expanding reasoning capabilities.
summary.zh: 通过测试时缩放分析在线蒸馏，揭示其主要改进采样效率而非扩展推理能力。

papers.title: When the API Speaks the Wrong Language: Revisiting Post-Training for Multilingual Tool Use

summary.en: Compares SFT and RL approaches for multilingual tool use, showing SFT effectively mitigates argument language mismatch in API calling.
summary.zh: 比较SFT和RL方法在多语言工具使用中的效果，显示SFT能有效缓解API调用中的参数语言不匹配问题。

papers.title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses

summary.en: Test-time harness design transfers capabilities from stronger to weaker models via inference-time scaffolding without parameter updates.
summary.zh: 通过推理时间支架设计，在不更新参数的情况下将强模型能力转移到弱模型。

papers.title: Claim-Level Reliability Assessment for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning

summary.en: Training-free test-time scaling via claim-level falsification and reliability assessment to compress reasoning traces and suppress erroneous consensus.
summary.zh: 通过声明级别伪造和可靠性评估进行无训练测试时扩展，以压缩推理轨迹并抑制错误共识。

papers.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection

summary.en: Training-free unlearning framework for RL-trained multimodal models using entropy dynamics to suppress privacy leakage in reasoning traces.
summary.zh: 使用熵动力学抑制推理轨迹隐私泄漏的RL训练多模态模型免训练遗忘框架。

papers.title: CLAIM: Leading Open-domain Active Clarification of Large Language Models with Uncertainty Measurement

summary.en: Uncertainty-driven framework for active clarification in LLMs using entropy-based synthetic data and GRPO training without human annotations.
summary.zh: 基于熵的不确定性驱动框架，使用合成数据和GRPO训练实现LLM主动澄清，无需人工标注。

papers.title: LoongReflect: Boosting Long-Horizon Reflection in Search Agents via Global Perspective Distillation

summary.en: Combines global distillation and outcome-based RL to train reflection and backtracking policies in long-horizon reasoning agents.
