summary.zh: 结合全局蒸馏和基于结果的强化学习来训练长期推理代理中的反思和回溯策略。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Shows the Path to a Tree: Realizing Branching Complexity

summary.en: Characterizes Chain-of-Thought expressiveness through explicit constructions of graph algorithms (DFS, Dijkstra) in bounded-depth Transformers, proving CoT's power for tree complexity measures.
summary.zh: 通过在有界深度Transformer中显式构造图算法(DFS、Dijkstra),刻画链式思维的表达能力,证明CoT对树复杂性度量的计算能力。

papers.title: REOPD: Reliability-Adaptive Reward Extrapolation for On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: Token-level adaptive reward extrapolation for on-policy distillation that prevents reward hacking through reliability-weighted coefficients.
summary.zh: 通过可靠性加权系数实现令牌级自适应奖励外推的在线蒸馏方法,防止奖励黑客攻击。

papers.title: ToolHazard: Scaling Adversarial Environments for Security Evaluation and Alignment of LLM-based Agents

summary.en: Synthesizes adversarial environments to evaluate LLM agent vulnerabilities to prompt injection and improves alignment through generated security data.
summary.zh: 综合生成对抗环境评估LLM智能体对提示注入的脆弱性，并通过生成的安全数据改进对齐。

papers.title: MBA: Multimodal Benchmark and Agents for Real-World Business Ideation

summary.en: Multimodal benchmark for business ideation agents trained via supervised LoRA fine-tuning and group relative policy optimization with creativity and feasibility rewards.
summary.zh: 通过监督LoRA微调和具有创意性与可行性奖励的群体相对策略优化训练的多模态商业创意代理基准。

papers.title: Preference Tree Optimization: Enhancing Goal-Oriented Dialogue with Look-Ahead Simulations

summary.en: Preference Tree Optimization generates synthetic preference data via look-ahead simulations for goal-oriented dialogue, optimized with DPO.
summary.zh: 偏好树优化通过前瞻模拟生成合成偏好数据用于目标导向对话，并使用DPO进行优化。

papers.title: GRPO for Financial Advice Generation: Outperforming Commercial LLMs under CATE Evaluation

summary.en: Fine-tunes open-weight LLMs using GRPO with LLM-judge rewards and causal auditing for financial advice generation.
summary.zh: 使用GRPO和LLM评判奖励对开源LLM进行微调，用因果审计生成财务建议。

papers.title: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model

summary.en: Scientific foundation model with unified post-training pipeline combining SFT, multi-task RL, agentic RL, and on-policy distillation for multimodal reasoning.
summary.zh: 科学基础模型，统一后训练流程结合监督微调、多任务强化学习、智能体RL和在线蒸馏用于多模态推理。

papers.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding

summary.en: Agentic framework for long-document understanding via adaptive visual resolution, trained with SFT and hard RL examples.
summary.zh: 通过自适应视觉分辨率进行长文档理解的智能体框架，采用SFT和硬RL样本训练。

papers.title: Full-bandwidth transformer

summary.en: Widens vertical feedback in autoregressive transformers via latent hidden-state feedback, improving reasoning and generation with minimal overhead.
summary.zh: 通过潜在隐状态反馈扩展自回归Transformer的纵向通道，改进推理和生成，开销最小。

papers.title: NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs

summary.en: Neuron-aware framework that selectively protects language-critical neurons while adapting plastic neurons during multimodal instruction tuning.
summary.zh: 神经元感知框架，在多模态指令调优中选择性地保护语言关键神经元同时适应可塑性神经元。

papers.title: I-SDPO: Instance-Level Adaptive Self-Distillation Policy Optimization

summary.en: Adaptive self-distillation policy optimization that routes between privileged distillation and GRPO based on per-instance success, improving reasoning on scientific tasks.
summary.zh: 自适应自蒸馏策略优化，根据实例级成功情况在特权蒸馏和GRPO之间动态路由，改进科学推理任务性能。

papers.title: Behavioral Reprogramming of Open-Weights Models: Cognitive Plasticity and Alignment Bounds

summary.en: Empirical study of parameter-efficient fine-tuning bounds and behavioral reprogramming of open-weight LLMs through LoRA and DPO.
summary.zh: 通过LoRA和DPO对开源LLM进行参数高效微调和行为重编程的实证研究，确定微调边界。

papers.title: Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation

summary.en: Learns privileged context end-to-end for on-policy self-distillation, enabling scalable agent self-improvement without hand-crafted supervision.
summary.zh: 端到端学习特权上下文用于在线自蒸馏，实现可扩展的智能体自我改进而无需手工监督。

papers.title: LongEarth-R1: Benchmarking and Aligning Vision-Language Models for Long-Horizon Earth Observation Reasoning

summary.en: Benchmarks long-horizon Earth observation reasoning and applies group relative policy optimization with structured rewards to vision-language models.
summary.zh: 为长视野地球观测推理建立基准，并将分组相对策略优化与结构化奖励应用于视觉语言模型。

papers.title: Follow the Norm: Accounting for Fine-Tuning and Prompt Effects on Model Rationales

summary.en: Demonstrates how norm-breaking fine-tuning shifts model rationales toward self-interest and shows system prompts can override alignment effects.
summary.zh: 展示规范违反微调如何将模型理由转向自利，以及系统提示如何能覆盖对齐效果。

papers.title: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning

summary.en: Gambit: thought-level beam search algorithm for efficient test-time compute allocation in reasoning models, pruning weak trajectories and concentrating compute on promising paths.
summary.zh: Gambit：思维级别束搜索算法，通过修剪弱轨迹并集中计算到有前景的路径，实现推理模型的高效测试时计算分配。

papers.title: Are You Sure You're Sure? On the Impact of Instruction Tuning on Confidence and Lexical Diversity

summary.en: Analyzes how instruction tuning affects model confidence calibration and lexical diversity of answer rationales in QA tasks.
summary.zh: 分析指令微调如何影响模型在问答任务中的置信度校准和答案理由的词汇多样性。

papers.title: CROP: Task Relevance via Counterfactuals for Selective On-Policy Distillation

summary.en: CROP improves on-policy distillation by selectively allocating token-level supervision based on task relevance via counterfactual sensitivity.
summary.zh: CROP通过反事实敏感性度量任务相关性，改进选择性在线蒸馏中的令牌级监督分配。

papers.title: TsuGO: Probing Search Efficiency in LLM Reasoning via Go Life-and-Death Problems

summary.en: Benchmark for evaluating search efficiency and reasoning-resource allocation in LLM reasoning via Go life-and-death problems with structured solution spaces.
summary.zh: 通过围棋死活问题的基准测试，评估LLM推理中的搜索效率和推理资源分配。

papers.title: HiRoute: Hierarchical Routed Prompt Tuning for Safety Alignment of Large Language Models

summary.en: Parameter-efficient safety alignment via hierarchical prompt tuning with input-adaptive routing and preference optimization.
summary.zh: 通过分层提示调优与输入自适应路由和偏好优化实现参数高效的安全对齐。

papers.title: Beyond Outcome Rewards: Step-Level Self-Distilled Policy Optimization for Deep Search Agents

summary.en: Step-level self-distillation with evidence anchors and advantage weighting improves credit assignment in deep search agents beyond outcome rewards.
summary.zh: 通过证据锚点和优势加权的步级自蒸馏，改进深度搜索代理中超越结果奖励的学分分配。

papers.title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning

summary.en: Uses RL with capability-aligned rewards to train models to refuse tasks beyond their abilities instead of generating futile reasoning.
summary.zh: 通过能力对齐的强化学习训练模型在超出能力范围的任务上拒绝回答，而非生成虚假推理。

papers.title: From Atomic Evidence to Logical Composition: Structured Compositional Reasoning over Compound Answer Options

summary.en: Decompose compound answer options into atomic judgments and compose scores via integer linear programs to improve logical reasoning.
summary.zh: 将复合答案选项分解为原子判断，通过整数线性规划合成得分以改进逻辑推理。

papers.title: Teach the Magnitude, Not the Direction: Verifier-Bounded Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn Multi-step LLM Agents

summary.en: Hierarchical credit assignment framework combining verifiable rewards and self-teacher distillation for multi-turn agent training.
summary.zh: 结合可验证奖励和自蒸馏的分层信用分配框架，用于多轮智能体训练。

papers.title: Numeracy in Large Language Models: Fundamental Limitations and Paths to Improvement

summary.en: Surveys numeracy failures in LLMs and evaluates mitigation strategies including fine-tuning, reasoning scaffolds, and external tools.
summary.zh: 调查LLM的数值理解失败，评估微调、推理支架和外部工具等缓解策略。

papers.title: GEM: A Generative Embedding Model Bridging Reasoning and Retrieval

summary.en: Generative embedding model combining reasoning and retrieval, with test-time compute scaling for improved dense retrieval.
summary.zh: 融合推理与检索的生成式嵌入模型，通过测试时计算扩展提升密集检索性能。

papers.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing

summary.en: Self-distillation method for knowledge editing that uses hybrid rollouts to improve composability of injected facts in LLMs.
summary.zh: 一种知识编辑的自蒸馏方法，通过混合采样轨迹提高注入事实的组合性。

papers.title: Refusing Intent, Not Form: Wrapper-Based Intent-Group Supervision for LLM Safety

summary.en: WIFA automatically pairs harmful and benign wrapped examples to teach models to refuse intent rather than surface forms, reducing over-refusal.
summary.zh: WIFA自动配对有害和无害的包装示例，教导模型拒绝意图而非表面形式，减少过度拒绝。

papers.title: APTER: Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics

summary.en: Framework using expert-grounded rubrics for fine-grained evaluation and targeted post-training optimization in specialized domains.
summary.zh: 利用专家制定的评分标准进行细粒度评估和针对性后训练优化的框架。

papers.title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning

summary.en: Tokenizer-agnostic on-policy distillation framework for transferring long-context reasoning from teachers to short-context students with stable training.
summary.zh: 无关分词器的在策略蒸馏框架，用于从长上下文推理教师向短上下文学生稳定地转移能力。

papers.title: Towards Efficient Multimodal and Multilingual Opinion Extraction for STI: A QLoRA-Based Fine-Tuning Approach

summary.en: QLoRA fine-tuning of VideoLLaMA2 for multilingual multimodal opinion extraction in science and technology intelligence.
summary.zh: 使用QLoRA微调VideoLLaMA2进行科技情报中的多语言多模态观点提取。

papers.title: P2Skill: Privacy Preserving Skill Distillation for Cloud-Local LLM Inference Systems

summary.en: Prompt-based skill distillation method enabling local SLMs to handle PII-aware task decomposition and routing without privacy-specific fine-tuning.
summary.zh: 无需隐私特定微调，通过提示词技能蒸馏使本地SLM能够处理PII感知的任务分解和路由。

papers.title: HELIX: Model-Harness Co-evolution for Recursive Self-Improvement

summary.en: Co-evolves agent harnesses and models through verified trajectory data, creating feedback between execution infrastructure and model training.
summary.zh: 通过验证的轨迹数据共同演进代理执行框架和模型，在执行基础设施和模型训练之间创建反馈循环。

papers.title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters

summary.en: sMuon adapts the Muon optimizer for parameter-efficient fine-tuning via low-rank approximation, improving over LoRA in SFT tasks.
summary.zh: sMuon通过低秩近似将Muon优化器适配参数高效微调，在SFT任务中超越LoRA。

papers.title: More Correct Mass, Worse Answers: Why Power Sampling Can Fail and How to Fix It

summary.en: Diagnoses and fixes Power Sampling's failure modes in test-time inference, proposing deformation-controlled sharpening to preserve reasoning diversity.
summary.zh: 诊断并修复Power Sampling在测试时推理中的失效问题，提出变形控制的锐化方法以保持推理多样性。

papers.title: Tripwire: Triggering Aligned Refusal via Statistically Certified Safety Neurons

summary.en: Training-free defense identifying safety neurons via hypothesis testing to trigger aligned refusal against jailbreaks with minimal utility loss.
summary.zh: 通过假设检验识别安全神经元的无训练防御方法，触发对齐拒绝行为以抵御越狱攻击，同时最小化效用损失。

papers.title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement

summary.en: Constructs verified autoformalization data via retrieval-guided generation and verification feedback, training MathForm-8B with SFT and RL.
summary.zh: 通过检索引导生成和验证反馈构建验证的自形式化数据，用SFT和RL训练MathForm-8B。

papers.title: CForce: Boosting Parallel Decoding for dLLMs via Consistency Forcing

summary.en: Distillation method forcing early-stage mask predictions in diffusion LLMs to align with later stages for improved parallel decoding.
summary.zh: 通过蒸馏方法使扩散LLM中早期阶段的掩码预测与后期阶段对齐，改进并行解码。
